recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a young woman in 90s streetwear, sitting cross-legged against a stark white background with a warm, golden-sepia color wash and prominent calligraphic text overlaid across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with text cutting across the mid-section
Warm ochre typography against a high-key white and cream background
Contrast between soft facial features and heavy, dark leather footwear
Harmonious color palette linking the brown hat, boots, and golden text
coreInvariants: High-key white background with minimal shadows
Warm, golden-yellow color cast on highlights
Subject in a seated, relaxed pose with hands clasped
Oversized 90s-era clothing including a newsboy cap and work boots

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame, seated on the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy boots at the bottom provide a grounded base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down through the large central text, and settle on the boots at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subject, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and mahogany (hat and boots)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high brightness; colors are warm and earthy.
paletteRestrictions: No pure blacks; shadows are warm brown

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, continuous strokes with varying thickness
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'b' features a large, sweeping loop
The 'y' has a long, curved tail that extends downward
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script font used for maximum brand recognition.
graphicDevices: Soft focus/glow effect on the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten 90s R&B vibe
Allows for the specific sweeping descenders seen in the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a young woman with braids wearing a brown newsboy cap, white t-shirt, and white overalls, sitting cross-legged on a white floor. High-key lighting with a warm golden-sepia tint. Focus on the texture of the brown leather boots in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered, lowercase calligraphic word in a golden-ochre color. The text should have a brush-stroke feel and overlap the subject's torso.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white but with a warm tint?
Does the text overlap the subject in the center?
Are the boots the darkest point of the image?
Is the typography lowercase and calligraphic?

adjustableVariables: Subject's specific streetwear items (e.g., denim instead of white overalls)
The specific word used for the central typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite overlapping the subject
Check that the warm tint is consistent across the subject and background
Verify the 90s fashion silhouette is maintained
Confirm the composition feels balanced and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + 90s streetwear + warm sepia wash + central calligraphic overlay.
